description: Start a proxy purchase for a person. This does not charge anyone: it returns payment_url for the person to pay, in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira in Nigeria. After a verified payment the proxies are issued within 10 minutes. Poll get_order_status with reference and status_token.

accept_terms.description: Set true only if your user agreed to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy on this website.

country.description: Optional: the payer's two-letter country. Outside Nigeria (NG) they pay in US dollars. Defaults to where the request comes from.

currency.description: Optional: USD or NGN. By default prices are in US dollars outside Nigeria and in naira inside Nigeria, from where the request comes from.

email.description: Required: the person's email, for their receipt and order details (the lines).

email_verification_token.description: verification_token from verify_email_code for this email (required while email checks are on).

gb.description: Pack size (GB, or Mbps for a speed tier).

offer_id.description: offer_id of the pack from list_proxy_products.

target_country.description: Optional: two-letter country the proxy lines should exit from.

name: create_proxy_order
